rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved programs: graduate courses at accredited colleges, seminars/workshops, conference programs, in-service training, distance learning and home study; behavioral health programs approved by AMHCA, IAMFC, AAMFT, AASCB, ACA, APA, CRCC, NAADAC, NASW, NBCC, national behavioral health bodies, other state counseling boards, ASCA and others
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal after initial licensure is exempt from CE.
rules.audit_note: The Board may audit up to 5% of renewal applications.

topics.who: LGBTQ cultural competency (separate from public health priority hours)
10% of required CE in DC Health public health priority topics

rules.notes: 4 of the 40 hours must be in trauma counseling (no topic code). Proof submitted with renewal. Moving to birth-month expiry (renewal in odd/even years matching birth year); transition: 50% CE accepted if under 2 years on the term, LGBTQ and public health hours still due.
rules.rule_quote: Six of the forty (40) hours shall be in Ethics and four (4) of the forty (40) hours shall be in Trauma Counseling.
